description: This file defines the CommandResponse class, which acts as a wrapper for payloads sent by devices in response to commands within the Eclipse Hono client project. It provides factory methods to create CommandResponse instances from request identifiers or messages, extracting relevant metadata, such as reply-to IDs and status codes, and constructs underlying AMQP messages.

classes.name: CommandResponse
classes.description: A wrapper around payloads sent by devices in response to commands. Provides methods to create instances from request IDs or messages, and access response metadata.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a CommandResponse instance from a request ID, tenant ID, device ID, payload, content type, and status code. Returns null if inputs are invalid.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a CommandResponse instance from an AMQP message, extracting necessary information like correlation ID, address, and status, and handling parsing to determine reply-to IDs and legacy endpoint usage.

methods.name: getReplyToId
methods.description: Returns the reply-to ID extracted from the request ID.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the correlation ID associated with this response.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code indicating the outcome of the command.

methods.name: toMessage
methods.description: Returns the underlying AMQP message representing this command response.

methods.name: isReplyToLegacyEndpointUsed
methods.description: Indicates whether the reply-to message was directed at the legacy control endpoint.
